title: WitnessLog dossier
description: The offline-verifiable record of one agent log: every leaf, the signed checkpoint, key bindings, revocations and witness receipts (SPEC.md §9). This schema states the SHAPE of the document. It is not the trust boundary: a document that validates is not verified. Verification (signatures, Merkle continuity, bindings, quorum) is SPEC.md §9.1–§9.2 and is what `witness-log verify` runs.

leaf.description: One log entry (SPEC.md §2–§3). Fields after payload_hash are present for every leaf and null unless the leaf type uses them; canonical_bytes() (the signed/hashed form) includes only the fields its type defines.

index.description: Position in the tree; leaves are contiguous from 0.

leaf_type.description: 0x00 PassiveMemory, 0x01 ActiveIntent, 0x02 ActiveResult, 0x03 Redaction, 0x04 KeyRevocation, 0x05 HandoffAttestation, 0x06 AuthorizationEvent, 0x07 ExternalAnchor

timestamp_ms.description: Self-asserted by the log; carries no evidentiary weight on its own (THREAT_MODEL.md).

session_pubkey.description: The session key this leaf was recorded under; must trace to a key binding by the identity key.

payload_hash.description: SHA256(bucket_pad(payload) || salt || index) per §8; the all-zero hash for leaf types that carry no payload.

redacted_index.description: 0x03 only: the index whose salt was forgotten.

counterparty_pubkey.description: 0x05 and 0x06: the other log's identity key.

handoff_state_hash.description: 0x05 only: unsalted SHA-256 of the handed-off state, identical in both logs (§3.1).

authorization_scope_hash.description: 0x06 only: unsalted SHA-256 of the scope document.

anchor_proof_json.description: 0x07 only: the anchor proof, verbatim; committed through anchor_proof_hash.

signed_tree_head.description: Checkpoint (SPEC.md §6). Signed message: "witness-log-sth-v2" || lp(sig_alg) || lp(signer_pubkey) || tree_size (8B BE) || root (32B) || timestamp_ms (8B BE).

witness_receipt.description:
A witness's countersignature over a checkpoint (SPEC.md §7). Native receipts sign "witness-log-witness-receipt-v2" || …; receipts with c2sp_origin are c2sp.org/tlog-cosignature v1 cosignatures and verify against "cosignature/v1
time <s>
<origin>
<size>
<base64 root>
" (§9.3).

c2sp_origin.description: Present for C2SP cosignatures; must equal the identity's canonical origin or the receipt does not count.

witness_directory.description: Display-only when it travels inside a dossier (§9.1): a verifier scores receipts against a directory it obtained itself.

operator_org.description: Operator identity for diversity scoring; normalised (trim, lowercase, collapse whitespace) before comparison.

is_project_operated.description: All project-operated witnesses collapse to one diversity bucket.

key_binding.description: The identity key's statement that a session key may sign leaves (SPEC.md §5).

not_after_ms.description: Binding expiry; null = no expiry asserted.
